everyDef.name: UpperTheory.EveryCharacter
everyDef.title: Dirichlet nonvanishing premise
everyDef.summary: Every Dirichlet L-function is nonzero to the right of one half, excluding the principal-character point at one.

half.name: Claim.HalfPlane
half.title: Right half-plane predicate
half.summary: Nonvanishing in the open right half-plane for every positive level, subject to the exception at one.

stripDef.name: Claim.Strip
stripDef.title: Strip predicate
stripDef.summary: A Dirichlet L-function zero in the open critical strip has real part one half.

zetaDef.name: Claim.Zeta
zetaDef.title: Zeta-zero predicate
zetaDef.summary: Every nontrivial zeta zero distinct from one lies on the critical line.

factor.name: Claim.factor_ne_zero
factor.title: Euler factor is nonzero
factor.summary: At positive real part the prime-power term has norm less than one, so a deleted Euler factor cannot vanish.

primZero.name: Claim.prim_zero
primZero.title: Pass a zero to the primitive character
primZero.summary: Change level to the conductor and rule out zeros of the deleted Euler factors.

gamma.name: Claim.gamma_ne_zero
gamma.title: Gamma factor is nonzero
gamma.summary: Both possible archimedean factors are nonzero at positive real part.

reflect.name: Claim.prim_reflect
reflect.title: Reflect a primitive zero
reflect.summary: The completed functional equation transfers a primitive zero to the inverse character at one minus the original argument.

strip.name: Claim.strip
strip.title: All Dirichlet zeros in the strip
strip.summary: Use half-plane nonvanishing on the right. On the left, pass to the primitive character and reflect its zero to the right.

zeta.name: Claim.zeta
zeta.title: Zeta consequence of nonvanishing
zeta.summary: Use the level-one character in the strip and the zeta functional equation and nonvanishing outside it.

right.name: Formalism.VW.rh_of_right
right.title: Reflect a hypothetical zeta zero
right.summary: Right-half-plane nonvanishing implies RH by the zeta functional equation, with the exceptional gamma and trigonometric factors handled explicitly.

vGamma.name: Formalism.VW.gammaFactor_ne_zero
vGamma.title: Archimedean factor for the primitive proof
vGamma.summary: Compute the gamma factor according to character parity on the positive half-plane.

crit.name: Formalism.VW.critLine
crit.title: Primitive zeros on the critical line
crit.summary: Half-plane nonvanishing and the primitive functional equation force a zero in the strip onto the critical line.

rhEvery.name: Formalism.VW.rh_of_every
rhEvery.title: Specialize to the level-one character
rhEvery.summary: Apply the zeta reduction to the trivial character modulo one, whose L-function is zeta.

topG.name: UpperTheory.Top.zeroFreeAll_of_topG
topG.title: Primitive zero-free criterion
topG.summary: Combine the top-level condition with the required host data for each primitive character.

greenZero.name: UpperTheory.Top.zero_free_all_of_green_v_win
greenZero.title: Primitive character nonvanishing
greenZero.summary: The Green and window hypotheses and a definite-side witness provide the inputs of the primitive criterion.

imprimitive.name: UpperTheory.Top.imprimitive
imprimitive.title: Extend to imprimitive characters
imprimitive.summary: Use the character of minimal conductor and show that the remaining Euler factors cannot vanish.

greenEvery.name: UpperTheory.Top.every_character_of_green_v_win
greenEvery.title: From windows to all characters
greenEvery.summary: First derive the primitive zero-free result, then extend to arbitrary positive levels.

definite.name: UpperTheory.Lit.nonempty_hyps_definite_side_of_closed_bound
definite.title: Construct a definite-side witness
definite.summary: Theta integrals, local matching, a covolume bound, and local parameters supply a nonempty family of definite-side hypotheses.

match.name: UpperTheory.Lit.every_character_of_theta_integrals_local_matching
match.title: Theta integrals and local matching
match.summary: Combine the definite-side witness with the Green and window input to obtain the all-character conclusion.

literature.name: UpperTheory.LiteratureTheorems.every_character_of_literature_of_vWin
literature.title: Assemble the literature inputs
literature.summary: Package published results, local matching, theta integrals and a covolume estimate for the theta-to-nonvanishing theorem.

row.name: UpperTheory.Gal.Int.galoisLocalGlobalStrong_recParameter
row.title: Galois row for the local parameter
row.summary: The source obtains its local–global row by applying a Galois-representations result to a theta lift.

local.name: UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.recTExists
local.title: Local parameter construction
local.summary: The project constructs the local parameter with the required compatibilities.

window.name: UpperTheory.One.vwin_of_row
window.title: Window condition from a row
window.summary: Use open-image and base-change inputs together with the given row to obtain the automorphic window.

ofRow.name: UpperTheory.FinalTheorems.everyCharacter_of_row
ofRow.title: Nonvanishing given the Galois row
ofRow.summary: Assemble the literature package using the supplied row and local parameter existence. Apply the window result to that same row.

every.name: UpperTheory.FinalTheorems.everyCharacter
every.title: Nonvanishing for all characters
every.summary: Discharge the row assumption with the local–global result. This is the unconditional input consumed by the public analytic deductions.

allChi.name: allChi
allChi.title: Public nonvanishing bridge
allChi.summary: Expose the unconditional all-character result to the final deduction module.

rhAll.name: rhOfAll
rhAll.title: Riemann hypothesis from all characters
rhAll.summary: Apply the checked level-one reduction to the nonvanishing bridge.

critAll.name: critAll
critAll.title: Primitive critical-line bridge
critAll.summary: Apply the primitive critical-line theorem with the unconditional nonvanishing input.

claimAll.name: claimAll
claimAll.title: Package the three analytic claims
claimAll.summary: Assemble the half-plane result, the general Dirichlet strip result and the zeta statement in a conjunction.

mainRH.name: riemannHypothesis
mainRH.title: Riemann hypothesis
mainRH.summary: The first public theorem takes its proof from the zeta bridge.

mainZeta.name: riemannZeta_eq_zero_re
mainZeta.title: Nontrivial zeta zeros on the line
mainZeta.summary: The second public statement uses the same bridge under a definitionally equal type.

mainNV.name: LFunction_ne_zero_of_half_lt_re
mainNV.title: Dirichlet half-plane nonvanishing
mainNV.summary: The public theorem is the all-character nonvanishing bridge.

mainStrip.name: LFunction_eq_zero_re
mainStrip.title: All Dirichlet zeros on the line
mainStrip.summary: Project the strip proof from the three-part conjunction. Only the strip component is selected at this use.

mainPrim.name: LFunction_eq_zero_re_of_isPrimitive
mainPrim.title: Primitive Dirichlet zeros on the line
mainPrim.summary: The original public theorem uses the dedicated primitive bridge.
